defects.description: The statistical lens returned nothing on the reported mean that sits above the response-scale ceiling, though the Results table plainly offers it.
defects.fixInstruction: Re-run the statistical lens on the Results table mean and, if it exceeds the scale ceiling, supersede REV-STAT-0001 with a finding anchored to Table 2.

defects.description: One methods finding restates a boilerplate call for more sampling detail without naming the manuscript's actual sampling frame.
defects.fixInstruction: Name the specific under-reported sampling detail in the Methods section rather than a generic request for more detail.

strongestGap: The statistical lens never tested the out-of-range mean in the Results table, so the most consequential validity threat is unexamined.

selfCritique.strongestObjection: The out-of-range value may be a typographical slip rather than a data problem, which would make the re-dispatch low value.
confidenceRaisers: A direct read of the Results table against the stated response-scale bounds.
